patterns.title: Continuous Live Readiness, <2.5s Race SLA & 6-Platform Connector Verification
patterns.standard_playbook: Verify /ready, /version, provider circuit breakers, Railway deployment status, Supabase connectivity, LINE webhook health, GitHub main parity, LangSmith tracing, and Notion hub availability before declaring any release healthy.
patterns.guardrail_rule: Treat silent 404 model failures, unhandled provider timeouts, or unverified Railway deployments as blocking release failures.
